name: SRE
summary: Today, the SRE agent investigates readiness failures in AKS preview environments. The goal is to investigate issues across the platform and propose fixes through GitHub pull requests.

flow.title: Readiness event
flow.detail: Argo Events watches the target preview workload.

flow.title: Broker Job
flow.detail: A short-lived Job collects workload state and recent events in AKS.

flow.title: Foundry agent
flow.detail: The broker submits evidence to a pinned, Entra-authenticated agent version.

flow.title: Diagnosis
flow.detail: The broker records the structured response and trace ID.

components.name: Hosted runtime
components.detail: A versioned Microsoft Foundry container serves the Invocations API. The Python adapter delegates to the shared agent runtime.

components.name: Model access
components.detail: The bounded-agent policy uses scoped reasoning, coding, and embedding connections through the shared LiteLLM gateway.

components.name: Monitoring and evidence
components.detail: The EventSource and Sensor launch a broker Job with its own workload identity. The broker reads the target workload and calls the hosted agent.

components.name: Notes and knowledge
components.detail: Caller-scoped notes and checkpoints support ongoing investigations. Reviewed runbooks provide context for retrieval.

components.name: Telemetry
components.detail: OpenTelemetry can export investigation traces with model and tool spans to the shared collector.

components.name: Delivery and evaluation
components.detail: The shared CI workflow builds and scans the image. Native Foundry deployment, hosted evaluations, and broker verification gate the monitoring integration.
